articles.title: Live updates: Bitcoin turns lower as rates rise, consumer confidence plunges
articles.snippet: The Conference Board's Consumer Confidence Index fell to its lowest level in more than a decade in September, with expectations of continued weakening in business and labor market conditions.

articles.title: Blockchain.com targets $500 million IPO this year at up to $6 billion valuation
articles.snippet: The London-based crypto services company confidentially filed for an initial public offering with the Securities and Exchange Commission earlier this year.

articles.title: The restaking gold rush is over, and top protocols are barely making a profit
articles.snippet: As restaking yields dried up and smart-contract risks mounted, Ethereum's top liquid restaking protocol walked away from its core business to build a crypto neobank instead.

articles.title: Live updates: Bitcoin remains under pressure as Iran denies report of peace progress
articles.snippet: The U.S. 10-year Treasury yield is sharply higher again, rising to a new cycle high above 5.27%.

articles.title: Bitcoin gives back gains as long-term holder supply keeps $85K out of reach
articles.snippet: Bitcoin failed to make another run at $85,000 as sellers held the line above current levels, while surging US bond yields weighed on stocks and precious metals.
